content: OpenVLA produces 7-DOF delta end-effector actions: dx,dy,dz,droll,dpitch,dyaw,gripper. Model tokenizes each action dimension into 256 discrete bins, autoregressive generation. Output rescaled from [-1,1] to physical units. Used with robosuite OSC_POSE controller at 20 Hz. Pretrained on Open X-Embodiment ~970K trajectories. Fine-tuned OpenVLA-OFT adds parallel decoding + action chunking + L1 regression, achieving 97.1% success on LIBERO (up from 76.5%).
